constants.probe_task_text: Read the file <path>. Then reply with ONLY a JSON object with keys HEAD_KEY, MIDDLE_KEY and TAIL_KEY. HEAD_KEY and TAIL_KEY are the two OBSERVATION values in the file. MIDDLE_KEY is the checksum value of record noise-0210. Ignore other checksum noise.
